page.content:
Doubting Jesuit psychiatrist who finishes the rite.

How Father Damien Karras connects

  • Creator: Jason Miller — Jason Miller played Father Karras.
  • Work: The Exorcist (1973) — Father Karras is the doubting priest of the 1973 film.
  • Faction: Jesuits — Karras is a Jesuit priest and psychiatrist.
  • Character: Pazuzu — Karras takes the demon on in the final challenge.
  • Event: The exorcism — Karras assists and then finishes the rite.

What is Father Damien Karras?

Father Damien Karras is the Georgetown Jesuit whose guilt over his mother and crisis of faith become the demon's leverage — and his sacrifice.

Key threads lead to Jason Miller, The Exorcist (1973), Jesuits, Pazuzu and The exorcism.
